=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Goal 3: "On a closed PR the job ends with success, merges nothing, releases the lease if it holds it, and logs one line: AUTOFIX_MERGE_SKIPPED pr=<n> head_sha=<sha> reason=pr_closed closed_at=<iso>."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, the judge's "not open" fall-through branches — merge arm at lines 3627-3634 and terminal arm at lines 3757-3763 (PR_STATE from the judge's own read at lines 3501/3506 merge arm, 3667/3668 terminal arm)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: When PR_STATE=closed, both branches set RB_MERGE_STATUS="not_open" and print "cannot merge (PR not open)" without emitting "AUTOFIX_MERGE_SKIPPED ... reason=pr_closed closed_at=<iso>" (or reason=pr_merged), the last run added AUTOFIX_MERGE_SKIPPED only inside `if [ -z "${PR_STATE}" ]` (reason=pr_state_unavailable, lines 3629-3632 and 3758-3761), neither branch calls _pr_merge_open_guard_release_lease even though _pr_json is in scope, the other refusal paths (det_skip_merge_open_guard, review_enable_auto_merge_open_guard, rb_judge_merge_open_guard, merge-train resume) do both, any held lease waits for the merge-train tick (holder_closed), and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash says no lease is held on this path (it exits before the lease-taking freshness call), so the impact is observability only. Suggested fix (sonnet): pass _pr_json to _pr_merge_open_guard as its 4th argument, with RB_JUDGED_HEAD_SHA as the bound head. All reviewers rated it NIT.
- requirement: Goal 2: "The same check runs when the job starts and when it takes or asks for the merge lease, so a closed PR does not take the lease, does not update its branch and does not wait on checks."
  expected_change_site: The first `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` call in scripts/review_rb_judge.sh (merge arm line 3534, terminal arm line 3673, merge_with_followup site line 4289), before rb_judge_merge_open_guard (lines 3552/3691); also scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh line 424 (per minimax_minimax-m3)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The merge flow calls _pr_base_fresh_for_merge at line 3534 and waits for required checks at line 3546 before rb_judge_merge_open_guard at line 3552. The terminal flow does the same: freshness at 3673, checks wait at 3685, guard at 3691 (gemini cites 3518/3549 and 3673/3691). _pr_base_fresh_for_merge can take or wait for the lease and update the branch (_merge_lease_gate at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2782/2823, _pr_base_sync_for_fresh_ci at scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2802, scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2782-2802, 2823-2835) and can run the inline merge's _pr_wait_for_required_checks (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3079). A PR that closes after the read at 3501/3506/3668 therefore takes the lease and can get a branch update before the guard refuses and releases the lease (3208). In review_enable_auto_merge.sh, the first freshness check at line 424 runs before the guard at 451, and the re-check at 476 only covers a second-freshness (line 459) head update. The judge's start read checks state only, not draft or head binding. Severity disagreement: MAJOR (gemini, minimax, luna) vs NIT (glm, short window, self-heals); highest is MAJOR. Disputed by anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5: the first freshness check at line 3534 runs only when PR_STATE is open, and the read at 3501-3506 is the last call before it.
- requirement: Goal 1: Every job that merges a PR in the review workflow reads the PR immediately before the merge and proceeds only when it is open, not a draft, and still at the bound head.
  expected_change_site: Final merge call paths in .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh, scripts/review_rb_judge.sh, scripts/review_merge_train.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The guards run before the freshness, lease and follow-up checks, which can take minutes, and the merge call comes after them. review_autofix.yml checks at lines 1692/1744 and merges at 1709/1761. review_enable_auto_merge.sh checks at 451/477, then runs the security follow-up guard before merging at 531/582. The judge and merge-train paths do freshness and follow-up work after their state checks. Both rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash did not adopt this gap: the last editor pass accepted the remaining short windows as residual, and the material inline-merge window is fixed at review_enable_auto_merge.sh lines 471-478 / 476-478.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  Expected change site: scripts/review_rb_judge.sh "PR not open" else branches, merge arm lines 3627-3634 and terminal arm near lines 3757-3763 (_pr_json line 3501, PR_STATE line 3506)
  Evidence of absence: The skip line appears only when PR_STATE is empty (reason=pr_state_unavailable). When PR_STATE=closed, the branch sets RB_MERGE_STATUS="not_open" with no pr_closed/pr_merged line and no _pr_merge_open_guard_release_lease call, unlike the other refusal paths. The lease waits for the merge-train tick (holder_closed). Fix: pass _pr_json to _pr_merge_open_guard as its 4th argument, with RB_JUDGED_HEAD_SHA as the bound head.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Not adopted: openai_gpt-6-luna pass-1 gaps (1) "no re-read immediately before merge": accepted residual, and the inline merge is covered at review_enable_auto_merge.sh lines 476-478. (2) "first freshness check before guard": line 3534 runs only when PR_STATE is open, from the read at lines 3501-3506.
- HARDENING: tests/test_cancel_on_pr_close_closed_pr_runs.py lines 1-10, module docstring: does not mention the PR_CLOSED_AT upper bound or the PR_MERGED linked-only rule (.github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml lines 367-395). Fix: add 1 sentence, about 2 lines. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1

  Expected change site: The first `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` in scripts/review_rb_judge.sh (line 3534 merge arm, line 3673 terminal arm, line 4289 merge_with_followup) and scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh (line 424)

That check can take the lease (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2782), update the branch (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2802) and wait on checks (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3079).
